headline: Cinnamoth Mysterious Scales
title: Cinnamoth | Mysterious Scales Farming Boost | Palworld Guide
video_script: Cinnamoth is a quiet base booster. Its partner skill, Mysterious Scales, attacks with Poison Fog when you use it. While it lives at your base, every other base Pal gets plus one Farming level, and it does not stack. It also works Planting, Gathering and Medicine Production at level two. Do you farm with Cinnamoth? Comment below!
description: Cinnamoth in Palworld 1.0: Mysterious Scales adds one Farming level to other base Pals, with Planting, Gathering and Medicine Production at level two.
